keys.manual_admin.tools.historial.title: Game History
keys.manual_admin.tools.historial.desc: Browse and download the results of every game played. Games are saved automatically when they finish.
keys.manual_admin.tools.historial.list_desc: Each game shows date, type, players, questions, duration and status (completed, finalized, abandoned or auto-saved).
keys.manual_admin.tools.historial.download_de: Download the results of any game or open them in the graphic viewer to analyze them with tables and charts.
keys.manual_admin.tools.historial.delete_desc: You can delete individual games, a selection or the whole history. This action cannot be undone.
